QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] The Grave of the Gods
QuestInfo.0: You should ask Archelon about Tallahart per Rusty's suggestion.
QuestInfo.1: Archelon confirms that Tallahart was once the home of many gods, but admits he doesn't know what happened there. You'll have to investigate it for yourself.
QuestInfo.2: You learned some things, but not why the Flora army is hovering around the ruins of Tallahart. Contact Neinheart with Hawkeye to assemble a plan of action.

default.0: The captain will prepare his special beverage.
